description_en: Lists the OpenAPI operations that currently support pricing inquiries
description_zh: 列出当前支持询价的 OpenAPI
name: ListSupportedPricingApis

parameters.help_en: The pagination token. Pass the nextToken value returned in the previous response. Do not pass this parameter for the first call. The current list contains fewer than 100 items, so all items are returned on a single page by default
parameters.help_zh: 分页 token：传入上一次响应里返回的 nextToken；首次调用不传。当前列表 < 100，默认一页就返完
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of entries to return on a single page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 本页最大返回条数。范围 1-100，默认 100
parameters.name: max_results

maxResults.description_en: The actual maximum number of entries returned on a single page in this response. This value aligns with the maxResults parameter in the request. Default value: 100
maxResults.description_zh: 本次响应的实际单页最大返回条数（与请求里的 maxResults 对齐，默认 100）
maxResults.title_en: 本次响应的实际单页最大返回条数（与请求里的 maxResults 对齐，默认 100）。
maxResults.title_zh: 本次响应的实际单页最大返回条数（与请求里的 maxResults 对齐，默认 100）。

nextToken.description_en: The token for the next page. If another page exists, this value is not empty and must be passed to the nextToken field in the next request. If the current page is the last page, this value is an empty string
nextToken.description_zh: 下一页 token。如果还有下一页则非空，把它传给下次请求的 nextToken 字段；如果已是最后一页则为空字符串
nextToken.title_en: 下一页 token。如果还有下一页则非空，把它传给下次请求的 nextToken 字段；如果已是最后一页则为空字符串。
nextToken.title_zh: 下一页 token。如果还有下一页则非空，把它传给下次请求的 nextToken 字段；如果已是最后一页则为空字符串。

supportedApis.description_en: The array of OpenAPI triplets that support pricing inquiries. The triplets are sorted in lexicographical order by popCode, popVersion, and apiName
supportedApis.description_zh: 支持询价的 OpenAPI 三元组数组（按 popCode、popVersion、apiName 字典序排列）

apiName.description_en: The OpenAPI name in PascalCase, such as RunInstances

popCode.description_en: The POP product code, such as Ecs, Rds, or Alb. This code corresponds to the popCode field used in pricing inquiries
popCode.description_zh: POP 产品码，如 Ecs / Rds / Alb（与询价时 popCode 字段一一对应）
popCode.title_en: POP 产品码，如 Ecs / Rds / Alb（与询价时 popCode 字段一一对应）
popCode.title_zh: POP 产品码，如 Ecs / Rds / Alb（与询价时 popCode 字段一一对应）
